recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Future changes to FormatCodes membership or expansion should be handled in THO/IHE/UTG unless a new FHIR-core issue changes the Endpoint binding itself.
issue_request: FHIR-20530 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 PA request reporting duplicate copied IHE FormatCodes concepts in the Endpoint payload type value set and asking to import the identified value set instead.
initial_application: Git commit 5fc677fa57632c25c76d2acac93f5d333b10dcb3 applied FHIR-20530 together with FHIR-28467 by removing the long copied concept list from source/endpoint/valueset-endpoint-payload-type.xml and adding http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-HL7FormatCodes.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread found the duplicate xphr entry, led to GF#20530, and later directed editors to use the THO value set and current DocumentReference pattern. Endpoint remains active and Endpoint.payload.type still binds to endpoint-payload-type.
reconciliation: No source change was made for FHIR-20530 because source/endpoint/valueset-endpoint-payload-type.xml already composes the local endpoint payload type CodeSystem plus http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-HL7FormatCodes with no copied IHE concept list.

related_jiras.note: Later Endpoint payload type issue requesting the same value-set handoff to proper FormatCodes terminology.
DocumentReference formatCode terminology handoff clarified ownership of IHE and HL7 format-code systems.
Moved Endpoint.payloadType to Endpoint.payload.type while retaining the same endpoint-payload-type binding.
